business_process: Import entry and ISF filing (customs brokerage)
description: Classify and value goods; prepare and transmit entries, entry summaries, and Importer Security Filings to CBP; answer CBP holds and requests; keep POAs current
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Cargo arrives most business days and clients pay demurrage and storage after free time; ISF data is due 24 hours before lading at the foreign port (19 CFR 149.2(b)); timely entries are a supervision factor (111.28(a)(11)); RPO set by the customs software vendor's backups
manual_workaround: Sign in to the customs software from a clean spare device over the phone hotspot; for a longer outage a backup broker files urgent entries under its own POA (not arranged yet; P01 R-005)
dependent_third_parties: Customs software vendor; CBP electronic systems; internet provider
dependent_people_or_facilities: Owner (single point of failure; only licensed broker); home office

description: Pay CBP for clients who prepay duties; wire freight to ocean carriers and overseas agents; collect client payments; account for client funds
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Duties must be paid by the due date and late client payments passed to CBP within 5 working days (111.29(a)); one misdirected wire can exceed a month of revenue; carriers hold cargo until freight is paid
manual_workaround: Phone the bank's business service line to send or stop a payment; visit a branch with photo ID; pay CBP on the client's own statement where the client agrees
dependent_third_parties: Business bank; accounting SaaS provider; carriers and overseas agents

description: Book cargo with carriers; exchange documents with overseas agents, truckers, and clients; arrival notices; status updates
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Bookings, arrival notices, and delivery orders move daily; clients expect same-day answers; lost email history is rebuilt from carrier portals and the customs software
manual_workaround: Phone and carrier web portals; the customs software's shipment notes; a temporary mailbox only after the domain is secured
dependent_third_parties: Email and file suite provider; phone carrier; ocean carriers and overseas agents

description: Arrange export bookings and documents; file Electronic Export Information as the exporter's authorized agent; keep export records
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Export cargo misses its vessel if documents or EEI are late; exporters have 8 accounts with predictable sailing schedules; export records kept 5 years (15 CFR 30.10(a)); RPO set by the customs software vendor
manual_workaround: Rebook on the next sailing; exporters can file their own EEI if they have access

description: Scanned records archive and paper files; invoices and bookkeeping; CBP portal submissions (status report, permit fee, point of contact); FMC license and bond
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Records must be produced within 30 calendar days of a DHS request (111.25(b)); billing can wait days; RPO of 24 hours is not supported today because the synced archive has no independent backup
manual_workaround: Rebuild shipment files from the customs software and carrier portals; invoice from the customs software; paper copies of the license, permit, and bond in the locked cabinet
dependent_third_parties: Email and file suite provider; accounting SaaS provider; contract bookkeeper
